review_response_tasks.rationale: 形容词heavy与重的、两人搬吻合。
仔细地对应carefully；不将谨慎地cautiously的语境近似当充分词义证据，其他形式待复核。
两副词均表示开心地向孙辈展示胜利。

filled_passage:
On Friday（星期五）, my grandmother（祖母） wanted to play chess in the garden（花园）. A small table usually stood beside the back door, but it was too low for her chair. We went to the shed to look for another one. The eighth（第八） table in the row was just the right height.

It was quite heavy（重的）, so my brother helped me carry it. We moved it carefully（仔细地） through the doorway, keeping both sides level. I wiped the top by myself（我自己） while Grandmother brought out the chess pieces. One black piece was missing, and we used a button in its place.

The first game lasted twenty（二十） minutes. My brother watched us, but he did not give advice during（在……期间） the game. At the end, Grandmother pointed to the winning move happily（高兴地）. I had lost, but the table had worked well. We left it under the roof by the door so that we could use it again the next day.
